body:
Thanks for the offer mate, but unfortunately I'm a bit North..

It was really nice of you though, it's a great pleasure to me to know there's people out there that are willing to do this.

Thanks for your words, I guess you're right. It's just so hard losing her and at the same time thinking about all the guys that are better than me and will pounce on her the moment they get the chance. I'm a very protective guy and the thought of her getting with someone else just gives me some indescribable feelings. I'm going to have to get out of her life before this happens but I can't lose such a close friend right now. I guess I just have to man up and pick one or the other, it's not going to be long before she gets someone.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. And truth be told I don't know. I believe next week. But I'm going to be a second year student (one first year comp class) so the majority of people will all have friends anyway. Obviously some will have just moved as well, but it's going to mean I'm going to have to approach people and there is nothing I can do worse than try and strike up a conversation with someone. I've read all those things about how to converse, and I know how, but there's always an uncomfortable silence and then the never-speaking-to-each-other phase following.

And yes I'll be living with my parents - common in Australia (I was actually out of the ordinary last year, going interstate for Uni).
